component.name: Heatr
component.summary: Control heat-based USB insect bite healers

description.p: Heatr is a free and open source app for interfacing with heat-based USB insect bite healers such as the heat it by Kamedi GmbH. Plug in a supported device, choose your settings, and run a heating session.
Warning: Heatr is NOT a certified medical product. It is not prove safe for use on human skin and the authors are not liable for any damage you do to yourself using it.
